raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 11  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the task was to identify the first Black student admitted to the University of Mississippi School of Law, when the actual task was to identify the first Black student admitted to the institution where Robert Khayat was educated, which is the University of Mississippi as a whole. James Meredith was the first Black student admitted to the University of Mississippi in 1962, not Cleve McDowell, who was admitted to the law school in 1963. This misunderstanding led to the wrong answer being provided.
